info.name: Hot Metal — OAuth MCP and Assistant Connections
info.description:
Production MCP enabled on 2026-10-29; hosted public OAuth startup checks passed. No hosted signed-in grant/token or consumer workflow proof is claimed. OAuth discovery, registration, code+PKCE, refresh, MCP protocol and Clerk consent/list/narrow/revoke. docs/mcp.md is canonical. Set variables using your test environment; never export live tokens. Same-client grants remain independent. Mutation Origin is required. Internal scout request is trusted service-only. Live ChatGPT/Claude validation is a separate release gate.

Conversational article writing is the primary flow: createWritingSession (publication optional), sendWriterMessage with turn idempotency, poll getWriterConversation, then listDrafts/getDraftVersion and request writer revisions. Private unassigned sessions belong only to the originating connection. New conversation deployment/model/consumer proof is tracked separately in docs/mcp.md.

request.description:

A copied Clerk JWT, proof and Origin alone do not complete consent. Browser/P​​ostman handles Cookie automatically.
